summary: Iteration 10 (frontend-only): Verified Sectors & Capital feature + in-page consent modal + hCaptcha widget. All critical review requirements PASSED. /explore renders 9 sector tiles, 22 agency tiles across 4 groups (Multilateral Development Banks, Global Climate Funds, Bilateral & DFI Partners, India Funds & Agencies), and 19 OEM tiles across 6 groups (Battery/Storage, Solar, Solar/Developer, Wind, Green Hydrogen, Developer). Deep-dive pages /sectors/storage, /capital/world-bank, /capital/adb, /oems/catl, /oems/waaree all load quickly with entity-title + expected field-* blocks + entity-news (8 items with source logos) + entity-videos. CRITICAL: Consent modal is truly IN-PAGE on both /login and /register — clicking consent-open-terms and consent-open-privacy opens a fixed overlay with data-testid consent-doc-modal, URL unchanged, ZERO new browser tabs opened (context.on('page') listener recorded 0 popups across full flow). Both consent-doc-close (X) and consent-doc-done ('I've read this') dismiss the modal. Checkbox correctly stays disabled until BOTH docs opened, then enables; ticking it enables login-submit / register-submit. hCaptcha widget renders on both pages (2 iframes present, no spinner stuck). Homepage: sectors-explore-cta present and navigates to /explore; 28 sector-chip-N chips render; verified chips for 'Renewable Energy' → /sectors/renewable-energy, 'Energy Storage / BESS' → /sectors/storage, 'Green Hydrogen' → /sectors/green-hydrogen, 'Climate & Green Financing' → /sectors/climate-finance (other sectors correctly fall back to /explore). Navbar 'Sectors & Capital' link points to /explore. React events (page.click, page.check) worked fine in my automation — no environment quirk observed on my end.
critical_code_review_comments: EntityPage.jsx uses field-key_oems / field-market_valuation / field-competing_tech / field-leader / field-tech_automation / field-efficiency for sector kind — the review request loosely referred to them as 'key players' and 'market'. Names are consistent internally, no bug. Consider aliasing to review-friendly names for clearer test docs.

entity-insights section is conditionally rendered only when data.insights.length > 0 (sector 'storage' currently has no insights → section absent). Correct behavior, but if 'SK Insights' is meant to be a first-class always-visible section per PRD, consider showing an empty-state placeholder.

Multiple '401 Failed to load resource' console errors on public pages (likely from /api/me or auth-probe calls firing before login). Cosmetic — should be silenced or gated behind hasToken() to keep the browser console clean.

Numerous ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED console errors on deep-dive pages — likely news source favicon/logo URLs that fail DNS. LogoImg has onError fallback (good), but the failed requests still spam the console. Consider server-side proxying source logos or caching them to /static.

Sectors.jsx uses `key={i}` on a duplicated marquee row (row = [...SECTORS, ...SECTORS]) so testids sector-chip-0..27 have two visually-different chips per slug at symmetric indices. React will warn on duplicate keys if SECTORS itself contained duplicates; fine today but fragile.
test_credentials: Not used — no login was required for this review; hCaptcha was verified as rendered, not solved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is stable. Testids to trust: /explore -> explore-sectors, explore-agencies, explore-oems, sector-tile-<slug>, agency-tile-<slug>, oem-tile-<slug>. EntityPage -> entity-title, field-<key> (see FIELDS map in EntityPage.jsx lines 13-48 for exact keys per kind — DO NOT assume 'field-market' or 'field-key_players'; real keys are field-market_valuation and field-key_oems for sectors), entity-insights (conditional), entity-news, entity-news-item, entity-videos. ConsentGate is a plain conditional-rendered fixed overlay (z-[200]) — NO new tabs, NO react-router navigation on doc buttons. hCaptcha renders 2 iframes; do not attempt to solve it in automation. If retesting, dismiss the cookie banner ('Essential only' button) before clicking consent-doc-close to avoid overlay z-index races.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
